job.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**À propos du poste**
=====================

Rejoignez l'équipe Customer Success d'Anthropic en tant que Customer Success Manager basé(e) dans la région EMEA, alors que nous façonnons l'avenir de l'adoption de l'IA en entreprise. En tant que Customer Success Manager chez Anthropic, vous serez partenaire stratégique et conseiller de confiance de nos clients les plus complexes dans la zone EMEA, les aidant à exploiter pleinement le potentiel de toutes nos fonctionnalités Claude : API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code.

Vous développerez de véritables partenariats avec les clients, acquérant une compréhension approfondie de leurs objectifs commerciaux, de leur orientation stratégique, de leur vision en IA et de leurs besoins techniques. Vous ferez appel à la fois à votre sens des affaires et à votre expertise technique pour agir comme conseiller stratégique tout au long de leur parcours chez nous.

En partenariat avec l'ensemble de l'équipe chargée des comptes, vous aiderez les clients à identifier les fonctionnalités Claude les mieux adaptées à leurs objectifs commerciaux spécifiques, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec eux pour leur fournir les meilleures pratiques et des conseils, tout en les aidant dans la croissance et l'évolution de leur utilisation (consommation et base) sur le siège.

Votre rôle consiste à aider les clients à adapter efficacement leur utilisation, à mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement, à optimiser les cas d'utilisation et à maximiser la valeur de leur investissement en élargissant les cas d'utilisation à l'ensemble de leur organisation. Les informations que vous recueillerez auprès de vos clients serviront directement à définir nos priorités en matière de recherche, de développement et

de stratégies de commercialisation, vous permettant de jouer un rôle clé dans la manière dont nous créons et fournissons de la valeur en continu en tant qu'entreprise.

En tant que l'un de nos premiers CSM dans la région EMEA, vous serez une pionnière en aidant à mettre en place des processus régionaux, à établir de nouvelles relations avec les clients et en représentant la marque Anthropic dans un

marché en forte croissance. Vous travaillerez avec une grande autonomie tout en maintenant un alignement fort avec les équipes mondiales, ce qui requiert une personne qui s'épanouit dans des environnements ambigus et peut travailler efficacement dans différents fuseaux horaires.

**Responsabilités :**
=====================

* Établir des relations de confiance et stratégiques avec les décideurs clés des clients EMEA afin de comprendre leurs activités et leurs objectifs, en identifiant des opportunités d'optimisation et d'expansion
* Devenir expert des produits Anthropic via API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code, en comprenant les nuances techniques et les meilleures pratiques de chacun afin d'orienter les clients vers les bonnes solutions
* Tirer parti de votre connaissance approfondie du client et des spécificités régionales pour piloter de manière proactive la planification de l'utilisation, en cernant les tendances actuelles et futures en matière de consommation et d'adoption, ainsi que la manière dont celles-ci se traduisent en valeur ajoutée pour le client
* Surveiller les schémas d'utilisation et identifiez les opportunités d'optimisation, en traitant de manière proactive la sous-utilisation des produits basés sur la consommation (API) et par abonnement (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) pour tirer pleinement parti des engagements contractuels
* Jouer le rôle de partenaire stratégique auprès des clients, en enrichissant leur connaissance des produits Claude grâce à la diffusion de la feuille de route des produits d'Anthropic, en faisant connaître les nouveaux produits et en impliquant les chefs de produit pour qu'ils se fassent le porte-parole des clients de la région EMEA
* Documenter et quantifier la valeur client réalisée grâce aux résultats commerciaux, au ROI et aux indicateurs d'impact afin de constituer des arguments commerciaux internes convaincants en vue de poursuivre et d'accroître les investissements
* Identifier les cas d'utilisation potentiels et les secteurs d'activité qui ne sont pas encore exploités, en collaborant avec les clients pour découvrir de nouvelles applications pour Claude au sein des différents services, équipes et flux de travail
* Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement pour favoriser l'adoption par les utilisateurs finaux et maximiser la valeur au sein des organisations clientes, y compris des programmes de formation des formateurs, le développement de centres d'excellence et l'accompagnement organisationnel
* Gérer l'expérience client tout au long de son cycle de vie : gérer des comptes complets et des plans de réussite fondés sur les objectifs commerciaux du client, réaliser des bilans commerciaux trimestriels et servir de principal intermédiaire entre le client et Anthropic
* Contribuer au développement de la marque Anthropic et des relations avec la clientèle en tant que membre de la première équipe de service client de la région, en élaborant, si nécessaire, des processus, des guides opérationnels et des bonnes pratiques adaptés à la zone EMEA et tenant compte des cultures d'entreprise régionales

**Profil recherché :**
======================

* Vous avez plus de 6 ans d'expérience dans des fonctions en contact avec la clientèle (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architect, Solutions/ Functional Consultant, Success Engineer ou similaire)
* Expérience avérée en matière de réussite dans les modèles commerciaux basés sur la consommation et sur la location de places, avec une bonne compréhension des différents leviers de croissance et des indicateurs de performance associés
* Maîtrise technique et capacité à comprendre et à articuler les concepts d'IA/ML, les intégrations d'API et les modèles de mise en œuvre logicielle
* Expérience dans la présentation et la démonstration de produits techniques auprès de publics variés
* Mentalité stratégique pour identifier les opportunités de croissance et les traduire en plans d'expansion concrets
* Collaborateur polyvalent qui représente le client avec positivité et proactivité, en mobilisant l'ensemble de l'équipe autour de solutions permettant de répondre aux besoins du client
* Solides compétences en gestion de projet et capacité à gérer plusieurs relations clients
* Passion pour l'IA et intérêt pour le développement responsable de systèmes avancés
* Acquérir de l'expérience en travaillant et en contribuant au développement d'une région en pleine croissance, tout en jonglant avec les fuseaux horaires depuis le siège social situé aux États-Unis
* Un talent pour mettre de l'ordre dans le chaos et une mentalité enthousiaste de « retrousser ses manches ». Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe
* (Bonus) Maîtrise du français, de l'allemand, de l'espagnol ou de l'italien

  

**About the role**
------------------

Join Anthropic's Customer Success team as an EMEA based Customer Success Manager as we pioneer the future of enterprise AI adoption. As a Customer Success Manager at Anthropic, you'll be the strategic partner and trusted advisor to our most complex customers across EMEA helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities - API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code.

You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us.

In partnership with the broader account team you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage (consumption & seat based) grows and evolves.

Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, implement change management strategies, optimize use cases, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.

As one of our early CSMs in EMEA, you'll be a pioneer - helping to build regional processes, establishing new customer relationships, and representing Anthropic's brand in a high-growth market. You'll operate with significant autonomy while maintaining strong alignment with global teams, requiring someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and can work effectively across time zones.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Build trusting, strategic relationships with key EMEA customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion
* Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions
* Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer and regional nuances to proactively drive usage planning, understanding current and future consumption/ adoption and how it creates realized value for the customer
* Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both consumption-based (API) and seat-based (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) products to drive full value from contracted commitments
* Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs as the voice of EMEA customers
* Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment
* Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows
* Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement
* Own the customer experience across their lifecycle — managing comprehensive account and success plans grounded in the customer's business objectives, conducting Quarterly Business Reviews, and serving as the primary conduit between the customer and Anthropic
* Build Anthropic's brand and customer relationships as a member of the first in-region CS team, developing EMEA-specific processes, playbooks, and best practices where needed that account for regional business cultures

  

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 6+ years of experience in customer-facing roles (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architect, Solutions/ Functional Consultant, Success Engineer or similar)
* Experience driving success across both consumption-based and seat-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each
* Strong Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns
* Experience explaining and demonstrating technical products to various audiences
* Strategic mindset to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans
* Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs
* Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple customer relationships
* Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems
* Experience working in and building a growing region, while navigating across time zones with US-based headquarters
* A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic 'roll up your sleeves' mentality. You are a true team player
* Fluency in French, Spanish and English

€150.000 - €190.000 EUR

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. job.description:
Result of Service

Successful operation of the UN-Habitat Global Social Housing Hub in Paris, effective coordination of the Paris-Nairobi partnership, and mobilization of additional resources enabling the Hub to progressively design and implement substantive technical assistance, capacity-building and knowledge-sharing activities in line with its Concept Note and its roadmap.

Work Location

Paris, France

Expected duration

12 Months

Duties and Responsibilities

Organizational Setting UN-Habitat, the United Nations Human Settlements Programme, is mandated by the UN General Assembly to promote socially and environmentally sustainable towns and cities, with the goal of providing adequate and affordable housing for all. Guided by its Strategic Plan 2026–2029, UN-Habitat places a renewed and strategic focus on adequate housing, land, and basic services for all, including the transformation of informal settlements and slums, in the face of rapid urbanization, rising inequalities, housing insecurity and growing homelessness worldwide. As per the World Cities Report, 2026, more than 3 billion people are currently affected by some form of housing inadequacy, a crisis that spans both industrialized and developing countries, and is driven by population growth, urbanization, forced displacement, climate change and economic pressures, including the financialization of housing markets. Aligned with UN-Habitat's Open-Ended Intergovernmental Expert Working Group on Adequate Housing for All (OEWG-H), established pursuant to resolution 2/7 of the UN-Habitat Assembly, UN-Habitat, the City of Paris and Nairobi City County have agreed to cooperate for the establishment and operation of a twinned Global Housing Hub (the "Hub"), anchored jointly in Paris, France, and Nairobi, Kenya. The Global Social Housing Hub The Global Social Housing Hub is conceived as a Technical Assistance Facility to promote the social and public good aspects of housing, and provide on-demand technical assistance, rapid knowledge and expertise transfer globally. This will include strengthening multilevel governance towards adequate housing for all; generating and implementing locally relevant housing solutions, taking account of related areas of land management and planning, basic services and informal settlements upgrading; and, enhancing cooperation between industrialized and developing countries. The Hub will operate as a lean, agile structure delivering a layered package of support comprising: Capacity-building for public officials and social housing providers (online courses, virtual and hybrid workshops, practical guidance); Housing Studios (hybrid and virtual) enabling city-to-city learning and knowledge exchange on pressing housing issues; Technical assistance, normative and policy advice supporting the design, implementation and scale-up of housing policies and integrated urban development approaches related to housing, as well as the corresponding regulatory frameworks; Knowledge development, by contributing to the Housing Knowledge Platform, centralising best practices, guidelines and data tools from national, regional and local governments, academia, civil society, IFIs and the private sector. The Hub also serves as the implementation platform for recommendations emerging from the Open-ended Intergovernmental Expert Working Group on Adequate Housing for All (OEWG-H), translating Member States' political commitments into technical cooperation, capacity-building and policy development. The Hub will actively seek collaboration with the numerous international organizations headquartered in Paris (including UNESCO, the OECD, UNEP, the IEA, and others) as well as with the Agence française de développement (AFD), the French National Housing hub, and, through UN-Habitat's Brussels Office, with European Union institutions. The institutional set-up envisages complementary personnel based in Paris and Nairobi: personnel in Paris comprising the Project Manager, supported by secondments; personnel in Nairobi; and a pool of specialized, on-demand experts and a wider network of academic, governmental, civil society and private sector partners. The implementation of the Nairobi component of the hub is planned at a later stage. Duties and Responsibilities; In close coordination with the supervisor: 1. Institutional Establishment and Hub Management Coordinate the operations of the Global Social Housing Hub in Paris Liaise with the French partners, Ministère de l’Europe et des Affaires étrangères, Ministère de la Ville et du Logement, Ville de Paris. Liaise with stakeholders as relevant to the Global Social Housing Hub initiatives and oversee the coordination of the pool of specialized experts and the wider partner network (academia, social housing providers, local/regional/national authorities, civil society, development banks, IFIs and the private sector); Coordinate, on a functional basis, the work of the personnel recruited by the Hub and of the secondees assigned to the Hub, in accordance with the applicable contractual and secondment arrangements; Liaise with the Nairobi-based counterpart team, once established, to ensure effective coordination of operations; Ensure the Hub operates as a lean, agile structure while maximising coherence between the Paris and Nairobi anchors; Contribute to UN-Habitat’s Digital Knowledge Repository esp. the Housing Knowledge Platform by inputting case material developed by the Hub. 2. Resource Mobilization and Partnerships Design and coordinate a resource-mobilization strategy to secure additional funding beyond the initial Contribution Agreements; Building on existing institutional partnerships, strengthen engagement with international organizations based in Paris (UNESCO, OECD, UNEP, IEA and others), the Agence Française de Développement (AFD); the French National Housing hub; and, European Union institutions and funding mechanisms in coordination with UN-Habitat Brussels Office. Participate on behalf of the Hub in relevant fora, including engagement linked to the OEWG-H, the World Urban Forum, the Global Urban Data Coalition, and other housing-related global and regional platforms; Support the Donors and UN-Habitat in preparing any joint public statements, communications or visibility material related to the Hub; Support building a set of global rosters of experts and partners for housing knowledge exchange, in alignment with other UNH initiatives such as the WUF, WUF academy and the stakeholder engagement mechanism - including academia and professionals, and facilitate their engagement with the activities of the Hub. Liaise with UNH knowledge hubs, regional and country offices, Canada office on housing research, knowledge hubs and partnerships offices as well as UN-Habitat’s housing reference group to map demand for housing studios. 3. Programme and Technical Guidance Coordinate the future design of the Hub's substantive workstreams, capacity-building, Housing Studios, technical assistance, and the Housing Knowledge Platform, for implementation once additional funding is secured; Provide technical inputs, drawing on international good practice in social and affordable housing, slum upgrading, climate-responsive housing, urban regeneration and multilevel governance, to support both the industrialized and developing countries’ dimensions of the Hub's mandate; Contribute to the operationalization of recommendations emerging from the OEWG-H. 4. Reporting, Monitoring and Compliance Prepare the annual narrative reports on performed activities and results, and coordinate the preparation of annual financial reports, in accordance with Articles III and IV of the Contribution Agreements and UN-Habitat's financial regulations, rules, policies and procedures; Liaise with Global Solutions Division and particular offices in UNH to ensure all future Hub activities financed by additional resources are entered into the Integrated Planning, Management and Reporting Module (IPMR) and submitted for review and approval by the Project Review Committee (PRC) Keep the Donors informed of relevant developments and promptly report any condition, event or situation that may affect implementation, in line with Article III of the Contribution Agreement; Support internal and external audit and evaluation processes relating to the Hub, as required under Articles II and III of the Contribution Agreement.

Qualifications/special skills

A minimum of five (5) years (with an advanced degree) or seven (7) years (with a first-level degree) of progressively responsible professional experience in housing, urban development or human settlements (especially the social aspects of housing) is required, including experience in an international or multilateral context is required. Demonstrated experience in institutional set-up, partnership development and resource mobilization is required. Experience working with, or in support of, United Nations agencies, multilateral organizations or local/national governments on housing and urban development issues is desirable. Experience in both industrialized and developing countries’ contexts, and familiarity with the New Urban Agenda and SDG 11, is an asset.

Languages

English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat. For the post advertised, fluency in English and French (both oral and written) is required, given the Hub's location in Paris and its role in engaging French and international institutions.

Additional Information

Not available.
